description: This file defines the ServiceMcaAction class, which facilitates executing service calls in either synchronous or asynchronous mode within the Apache OFBiz framework. It manages parameters such as service name, mode, and user context, and provides the runAction method to trigger the service operations based on configuration.

classes.name: ServiceMcaAction
classes.description: Implements a serializable class that manages the execution of service calls with support for synchronous and asynchronous modes, handling user context and persistence options.

methods.name: getServiceName
methods.description: Returns the name of the service to be invoked.

methods.name: runAction
methods.description: Executes the configured service action either synchronously or asynchronously based on the service mode. Handles user context and error logging.
